name: mjlab-restorable-sensor-checkpoints
instr:
Let callers pause, branch, serialize, and resume sensor state for selected batched environments without disturbing other environments. Checkpointing must span individual sensors, named Scene collections, Simulation sensing, and ManagerBasedRlEnv lifecycle boundaries. Existing caching, reset, update, stepping, observation, and manual-reset behavior must remain unchanged when checkpointing is unused.

Every sensor kind, including BuiltinSensor, CameraSensor, ContactSensor, RayCastSensor, and TerrainHeightSensor, captures an independently owned portable checkpoint and restores exactly its selected rows while preserving all unselected observable state byte-for-byte. Compatible restoration reproduces persistent and temporal state coherently, while context-derived camera, raycast, and terrain-height products remain valid only until the next shared sensing boundary. Sensor identity, kind, environment selection, and checkpoint version are validated before mutation, with incompatibility reported as CheckpointCompatibilityError carrying sensor_name and reason. Scene restoration is atomic across its complete named sensor collection, including empty collections, so missing, extra, invalid, or incompatible entries leave every sensor unchanged. checkpoint_to_bytes(checkpoint) and checkpoint_from_bytes(data) provide deterministic, resource-independent round trips that preserve tensor dtype, shape, value, identity, and row order; malformed or unsupported input raises CheckpointFormatError ca
